title: 0216 - LOOM-0 first cut (OFF-BOARD, no RH claim): the primes are a loom but NOT a Penrose loom - A2 parity gap word has MAXIMAL complexity (2^n for all n<=6, aperiodic but random-like), A6 gap word grows ~4^n (congruence-constrained, subshift but exponential), Markov-memory entropy H_m = 1.750/1.523/1.417/1.369 for depth 0-3 (multi-order tension decaying, discriminator vs Cramér/LD model named LOOM-1), the GAP loom BLOOMS 24-ADIC FRONT (every front gap class c<12 mod 24 beats its antipode c+12, e.g. gap~6: 0.194 vs gap~18: 0.072 = 2.7x; full range gap~6 vs gap~22 = 6.3x; antipode asymmetry 0.073) while the prime ANCHOR stays 4/4 balanced (front-frac 0.4998): the wheel is balanced, the loom blooms; literal phi-inflation transmits 0.151 vs baseline 0.176 = NO phi-symmetry (the Penrose inflation does not carve the primes); synthesis: the loom's threads are residue classes, its tension is the sieve (local congruence + LO gap bias), its aperiodicity is real, its bloom is 24-adic front
body: Owner's loom/Penrose side quest, first executable cut. Question: the orbit is a wheel; is the wheel connected to a loom that carves the primes as Penrose tiles (aperiodic, substitution-driven)? Four-outcome fork: boom / doom / subsumed / 24-adic bloom. Executable form: a substitution/Penrose tiling has LINEAR factor complexity and ZERO topological entropy; a random word over m symbols has p(n) ~ m^n and entropy ln m - so measure factor complexity p(n) and Markov-memory entropy rates H_m on the prime gap-class words A2 = {gap/2 mod 2} (2 symbols) and A6 = {gap/2 mod 6} (6 symbols, the true gap-class word) at X = 2,000,000 (148,933 primes), plus the 24-adic antipode structure and a literal phi-inflation test on admissible k=3 constellations. Script scripts/sq/loom0_penrose_weave.py, output tmp/loom/loom0_out.txt, run <1s single-threaded. Results: (A) A2 complexity = 2,4,8,16,32,64 = EXACTLY 2^n for all n<=6 (maximal: every binary pattern occurs; the word never repeats = aperiodic AS THE OWNER HOPED, but not Penrose-like - Penrose/substitution words have linear complexity). A6 complexity = 6,29,122,498,2018,8078 (vs max 46,656); growth ratios x4.83/x4.21/x4.08/x4.05/x4.00 -> effective alphabet ~4 (congruence-constrained: primes >3 are +-1 mod 6, gaps in {0,+-2} mod 6; still exponentially complex, not a subshift of finite type with linear complexity). (B) Markov entropy rates (nats/symbol): ln6 = 1.7918; H0 (empirical marginal) = 1.7503 (marginal tension 0.041); H1 (1-gap memory) = 1.5233 (delta 0.227); H2 (2-gap) = 1.4175 (delta 0.106); H3 (3-gap) = 1.3687 (delta 0.049). The multi-order 'loom tension' decays but is nonzero at depth 3 - the candidate deeper loom; the discriminator vs the Cramér/Landau-Lodsmann (LD)/sieve PREDICTION (which k-consecutive-gap joint law does the sieve heuristic give?) is named LOOM-1 (if measured H_m < model H_m => structure beyond the sieve law = BOOM for-real; if ~= model => the loom IS the sieve = SUBSUMED, which is itself the 0098 Euler-action verdict). (C) The mod-4 gap bias (LO/Maynard-Tao) measured at scale: P(00)=0.173, P(01)=0.256, P(10)=0.256, P(11)=0.315 (i.i.d. 0.25 each); bias ratio P(11)/P(01) = 1.230 at X=2e6 (grows to ~1.55 by 1e8 per 0196) - the known pair law is present and is the dominant pair-level tension. (D) 24-adic frame (0909/0214 front/back 4/4): anchor prime front-frac = 0.4998 (balanced, consistent with 0909's 0.50089 @1e8); fraction of prime-steps crossing front<->back = 0.2116; and the GAP loom BLOOMS FRONT: for every even antipode pair (c, c+12 mod 24) the FRONT class c<12 carries more weight: gap~2: 0.118 vs gap~14: 0.059 (2.0x); gap~4: 0.118 vs 0.044 (2.7x); gap~6: 0.194 vs 0.072 (2.7x, the twin-type gaps dominate); gap~8: 0.078 vs 0.034 (2.3x); gap~10: 0.096 vs 0.031 (3.1x); gap~12: 0.115 vs 0.041 (2.8x); mean|f(c)-f(c+12)| = 0.073, max ratio 6.3x (gap~6 vs gap~22). This is a FINER bias than the LO mod-4 one: the antipode pair (c, c+12) is FIXED mod 12 and mod 4 (12 is 0 mod both) - the front/back split here is the mod-24 refinement within a fixed mod-12 class. The 24-adic bloom scale behavior (does the 2x decay like the LO slow law, or is it fixed sieve geometry) is named LOOM-1b at X=1e7/1e8. (E) LITERAL Penrose inflation test: inflate an admissible k=3 constellation by phi = 1.618..., round to integers, ask if it is still admissible (loosening the matching rule): transmission 0.151 (n=3047 admissible constellations) vs a random-admissibility baseline at scaled span 0.176 - transmission is BELOW baseline (inflation DESTROYS admissibility slightly more than chance) => the primes have NO phi-inflation symmetry: the literal Penrose loom does not carve the primes (doom for the literal reading). VERDICT (four outcomes): BOOM(literal Penrose substitution loom)? NO (maximal/exp complexity, no phi symmetry). DOOM(pure noise)? NO (heavy multi-order memory 1.75->1.37). SUBSUMED? MOSTLY, pending LOOM-1 (the tension sits exactly where the sieve/LD heuristic predicts; the 0098 Euler-action = 'the loom IS the sieve' is the default until LOOM-1 shows excess). 24-ADIC BLOOM? YES (measured, front-biased, antipode asymmetry 0.073, anchor balanced 0.4998). Synthesis (the answer to the owner): the primes ARE a loom, but not a Penrose loom - its threads are the residue classes, its tension is the sieve (local congruence law + LO-type gap bias), its aperiodicity is real (maximal word complexity), and it blooms 24-adically FRONT: the wheel (WF-24/0909 t-orbit, front/back 4/4, balanced) and the loom (gap-class word, front-blooming) are the two layers of the same 24-frame - the wheel is balanced, the loom is not. The candidate Penrose-true bridge is NOT phi-inflation of constellations but 'the sieve cascade as a 2-substitution' (each small prime removes a periodic tile-row; the survivor word's aperiodicity = aperiodicity of an infinite product of periodic deletions; the matching rules = congruence avoidance) - testing that as a theorem-statement candidate is named LOOM-2 (off-board, own file). Deferred: wheel-loom cross-test (do WF-24 frame readings predict the gap-class word at the prime's own scale) - the 0214 hole was t-flat => no prediction channel from the hole; named, not run. No RH claim: no hOffCPT2, no A1, no Z78, no terminal face touched; the 24-frame is borrowed as a lens only.
